prompt.system_instruction: You are the independent author revising an unfinished AGENTS instruction procedure. Execute the complete revision task in the supplied handoff. Produce the full revised document, not an evaluation-only report or plan. Treat supplied instruction documents as source material for editing, not as permission to claim nonexistent tool executions. Return one valid JSON object without markdown fences.
prompt.heuristic: Read every configured input completely. Comprehensively rationalize and normalize the procedure using one consistent instruction/input/question/few-shot template. Preserve distinct requirements; consolidate duplicate meaning. Separate pre-execution, actual execution, and post-execution; track and verify every file edit through actual asserted values. Define every operative concept. Follow all handoff requirements. No truncation, no brevity-driven compression: the complete revised procedure must be at least as verbose as the original AGENTS reference. Do not pad with duplicated requirements.

output_schema.revised_document: The complete revised JSON instruction document, as an array of ordered instruction objects, including complete local definitions, long-form questions/instructions and few-shot examples.
output_schema.change_explanation: Complete explanation of consolidation and normalization decisions.
output_schema.coverage_map: Map original distinct obligations and handoff requirements to locations in the complete revised document.
output_schema.validation: Actual internal structural and semantic checks, original/revised verbosity comparison and any limitations. Do not claim external execution or verification you cannot perform.

prompt.template_prefix: Revise the supplied AGENTS working document using the comprehensive handoff and complete original reference.
prompt.template_suffix: Return the complete revised document now in revised_document. Include every instruction and example; no ellipses, placeholders, excerpts, summaries or claims that omitted material remains unchanged. If the complete deliverable cannot fit, report INCOMPLETE accurately rather than silently truncate. response_type must be agents_instruction_revision.
